evidence.observation: The ASR describes bonuses associated with signing up and making a deposit; the word 'weeks' appears to be a transcription error in the exchange name.
evidence.quote: when you sign up to weeks, you get a bonus just for signing up. Make a deposit and then you're gonna get another.

evidence.observation: The presenter identifies linking a phone number and an account as stated bonus-related tasks.
evidence.quote: simple tasks like linking your phone number and your account.

evidence.observation: The presenter lists making deposits and moving funds to a Futures account among the stated bonus-related tasks.
evidence.quote: things like making deposits or moving some of your main account to the Futures account.

evidence.observation: The description identifies Weex as the video sponsor.
evidence.quote: This video is sponsored by Weex.

evidence.observation: The presenter frames investing as a viewer choice while discussing cryptocurrency.
evidence.quote: all the best of luck if you choose to invest

evidence.observation: The presenter characterizes the discussed LINK price as a potentially favorable entry.
evidence.quote: at these numbers you're looking at a great entry for link

evidence.observation: The description includes an explicit financial-advice disclaimer.
evidence.quote: Disclaimer The information discussed by Altcoin Buzz is not financial advice.

evidence.observation: The description characterizes cryptocurrency investments as high risk and advises due diligence.
evidence.quote: Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies are high-risk investments so please do your due diligence.

evidence.observation: The presenter states that a $150 USDT amount can be added to the account as part of the promotion.
evidence.quote: you can earn $150 in USDT added right to your account

evidence.observation: The presenter directs viewers to click the description link to obtain the promoted bonuses.
evidence.quote: click the link in the description of this video and get your bonuses

evidence.observation: The description advertises a stated welcome-bonus amount and a no-KYC condition.
evidence.quote: Get up to 30000 USDT | Welcome Bonus | No KYC

evidence.observation: The description discloses possible commission from clicks followed by a purchase through a partner link.
evidence.quote: Altcoin Buzz may receive a commission, at no extra cost to you, if you click through our links and make a purchase from one of our partners.
